candidate.name: Uncracked City
candidate.summary: Uncracked City, detective game where you question LLM suspects that lie. To give you some context on the project. I'm a solo founder and I use AI heavily in my work. The idea came from wanting players to discover cities. Each city has its own history, so every case is set in a real city with real public places. The crime and the people are on other hand invented. The part that I care most is the playable aspect of the game, a model plays the detective and must solve the case before it goes live. As of today: it's free on Android, the iOS version is still waiting to be reviewed by Apple. It's available in six popular languages, but adding more languages is just a matter of time and demand.My long term vision if it takes off: weekly cases, private parties like a team-building escape game, an MCP so a game master can build their own scenario from ChatGPT or Claude, and maybe tourism offices since players travel the world.

score.reason: LLM 嫌疑人会撒谎的侦探游戏，机制清晰可拆（审讯、谎言、真实城市背景），已有 Android 免费版和六语言，适合作为 AI 产品经理分析'AI 角色可信度与游戏化'的案例。

Salem, the morning after Halloween. Meg Ashcombe, the last of her family, lies at the foot of her grand staircase, one slipper on the thirteenth step, the front door bolted from the inside. Half the town says the Gray Captain finally took her.
Four suspects. One of them lies.
Nobody has cracked it yet
Play in your browser
Watch the teaser on YouTube
Every case happens in a real neighborhood. Find the clues, open what is locked.
Question the suspects
Ask your own questions, typed or spoken, in any of the game's six languages. Each suspect answers in their own voice. Some of them lie.
Catch the lie, then file your report
Put a clue up against a suspect's statement. When the lie cracks, write your report: three tries, not one more.
A world tour to learn the ropes. Then the real cases.
Paris, Rio de Janeiro, Marrakech, Tokyo, Sydney: five training levels, each harder than the last. Then come the real cases, harder still. Each one shows how many investigators have solved it. For most of them: nobody. Not yet.
Nobody has cracked it yet
One city, one secret
The first time you open a case, you fly there across the map. Solve it, and its city is stamped in your passport.
A question, a bug, a suspect's reply that goes wrong: write to us. In the game, tap “Flag” under a suspect's reply to send that reply straight to us.
hello@uncracked.city
The game is played without an account. To erase everything, tap your portrait in the game, then “My data” → “Start over” → “Erase everything”. If you no longer have the phone that created your player, write to us.

evidence.title: Uncracked City
evidence.excerpt:
Talking to lying LLMs is what I do all day for work. Can’t imagine I’d want to do the same in my free time.
When I was growing up there was a wonderfully made interactive “novel” game on early Macintosh called Sherlock Holmes. I’ve always wondered when we’ll get to a point where this can be done ad-hoc with any potential crime thriller. LA Noir introduced nuanced facial movements and dialog chains but I keep going back to that 1990s era Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective.
You should probably put some better examples of writing in the first trailer, especially if the game involves a lot of reading. Asides from just sounding horribly bland, there's only two sentences of dialogue shown and the character says "honestly" in BOTH of them.
Cool concept! It reminds me of the 1985 videogame Where in the World Is Carmen Sandiego. What a blast!
haha very neat! Just curious how are you planning to make it free with the inference cost? Even with a luna or haiku its still a non zero cost to run per session.

verified_facts: Uncracked City 是一款侦探游戏，背景设定在真实城市，玩家需要搜索地点、审问嫌疑人、找出谎言并撰写报告。
游戏官网提供浏览器版本，标注为免费、无需下载、手机或电脑均可游玩。
官网提供 App Store 和 Google Play 下载入口。
游戏包含六个嫌疑人？不，官网写明每个案件有四个嫌疑人，其中一人说谎。
玩家可以用打字或语音提出自己的问题，嫌疑人以各自的口吻回答，部分嫌疑人会说谎。
游戏包含五个训练关卡，分别设在巴黎、里约热内卢、马拉喀什、东京和悉尼，难度依次递增。
每个案件会显示已破解该案的调查者人数，官网称大多数案件尚无人破解。
玩家撰写报告有三次尝试机会。
游戏无需账号即可游玩，并提供数据擦除选项。
官网版权归属为 BNT TECHNOLOGIES，年份为 2026。
创始人自述为独立开发者，Android 版免费，iOS 版仍在等待 Apple 审核。
